learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding of the engineering disciplines specific to their specialty, at the necessary level to acquire the rest of the degree's competencies, including notions of the latest advances.
Being aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

The ability to analyze complex products, processes, and systems in their field of study; to choose and apply relevant established analytical, computational, and experimental methods and to correctly interpret the results of these analyses.

The ability to identify, formulate, and solve engineering problems in their specialty; to choose and apply appropriate established analytical, computational, and experimental methods; to recognize the importance of social, health and safety, environmental, economic, and industrial constraints.

Ability to perform bibliographic searches, consult and critically use databases and other sources of information, to carry out simulation and analysis with the aim of conducting research on technical topics in their specialty.
Ability to consult and apply good practice and safety codes in their specialty.
Ability and skill to plan and carry out experimental research, interpret results and draw conclusions in their field of study.
Understanding of the applicable techniques and methods of analysis, project, and research and their limitations in their specialty.
Practical competence to solve complex problems, carry out complex engineering projects and conduct research specific to their specialty.
Knowledge of the application of materials, equipment and tools, technology and engineering processes and their limitations in their specialty.
Ability to apply engineering practice standards in their specialty.
Ability to collect and interpret data and manage complex concepts within their specialty, to make judgments that involve reflection on ethical and social issues.
Ability to manage complex technical or professional activities or projects in their specialty, taking responsibility for decision-making.
Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems, and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with both engineers and people from other disciplines.
Ability to stay up-to-date with developments in science and technology.
Performs both preliminary dimensioning and design and technical documentation of the analyzed mechanical transmission.

assessment_methods.method: Project/PBL assessment (technical capacity, involvement, work performed, results obtained, submitted documentation, presentation, and technical defense)
Individual written and oral tests for technical competencies
Oral and written presentations of problem-solving proposals
Reports and memos of developed exercises and practicals
Written or oral tests for the evaluation of theoretical concepts and fundamentals

assessment_rules: The assessment and recovery of work will be continuous, with partial discharges and feedback.
